source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    by_residue = {r: Counter() for r in range(3)}
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        for j, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0:
                by_residue[(j-i) % 3][value] += 1
    colors = {}
    for r in range(3):
        if by_residue[r]:
            colors[r] = by_residue[r].most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The marks encode all three diagonal classes in the demonstrations.
    # For any unmarked residue, use the color distinct from the observed classes if possible.
    used = set(colors.values())
    for r in range(3):
        if r not in colors:
            colors[r] = next((v for v in used if v not in colors.values()), next(iter(used)))
    return [[colors[(j-i) % 3] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
'''
